summary: Iteration 1 - both backend & frontend tested. 18/18 pytest tests pass; all 7 frontend playwright tests pass. App works end-to-end: smoke, auth (401 anon, 200 admin/employee), admin RBAC (403 for employee on admin endpoints), attendance flow (check-in -> double-check-in 400 -> ping -> check-out with duration -> ping-not-on-duty 400), location/today ordered, admin route inspector, role flip + cannot demote self + invalid role. Frontend: login page renders, admin cookie redirects to /admin and shows stats blocks (2 employees seeded), employees-list, attendance-log; clicking emp row populates Route Inspector with selected name; date filter changes attendance log; employee cookie redirects to /dashboard with OFF DUTY indicator and check-in button; logout clears session and returns to login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin/stats: on_duty count uses {check_out: None} across ALL dates, so a forgotten checkout from a previous day will still inflate the 'on duty' count. Consider scoping to today's date or treating stale active sessions as auto-closed.
server.py admin/employees: same 'check_out: None' query is used for the active_map; same stale-session concern.

server.py auth_session: cookie is set with secure=True, sameSite='none' (correct for cross-site) but does not include domain; relies on default host-only cookie. Works for the single preview domain but may cause issues if the frontend domain ever differs.

server.py check_in: comment says 'multiple sessions allowed' but only blocks when an active record exists for the user globally — fine, but unique index on (user_id, record_id) is missing; consider adding indexes (user_id, date) and (session_token) for production scale.
Dashboard.jsx: if geolocation is denied, check-in fails silently with toast but PWA offers no graceful fallback or retry guidance — acceptable for MVP.
auth.jsx: only refresh on mount; if /auth/me 401s after cookie expiry mid-session, there's no global axios interceptor to redirect to /login — UX issue.
No data-testid on the Route Inspector pings/timeline rows; fine for current tests.
test_credentials: Seeded directly in MongoDB during tests: admin user_id=TEST_user_admin01 token=TEST_session_admin_001; employee user_id=TEST_user_emp01 token=TEST_session_employee_001. Cleanup performed after test run.
seed_data_creation: Test users/sessions inserted via mongosh and pytest fixtures; cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/. Conftest auto-seeds TEST_ prefixed admin+employee sessions in mongo and cleans them up. To re-test frontend, re-seed sessions and use page.context.add_cookies with domain=employee-locator-4.preview.emergentagent.com, sameSite=None, secure=True, httpOnly=True. Geolocation tested only at API level; UI check-in/checkout buttons require browser geo permission grant (use page.context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) and set_geolocation).
